subject: ancient gate between worlds: a freestanding upright ring of weathered grey fieldstone, about three metres tall, built of large fitted wedge-shaped stone blocks like an arch carried full circle, standing on a low plinth of two worn stone steps half sunk in the ground; a band of shallow carved spiral runes runs round the ring's inner face; moss and pale lichen on the lower stones; the round opening is empty, a person could walk through it
